description: Defines the EmbedElement custom HTML element class, managing themes, layout, skeleton loading, and system theme preferences for embedded content.

classes.name: EmbedElement
classes.description: Custom HTML element for embedding content with theme, layout, and skeleton loading management.

methods.name: assertHasShadowRoot
methods.description: Asserts that the element has a shadow root.

methods.name: getPageType
methods.description: Returns the page type from dataset.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Determines the layout based on dataset.

methods.name: getSkeletonContainerElement
methods.description: Retrieves the skeleton container element from shadow DOM.

methods.name: getSkeletonElement
methods.description: Retrieves the skeleton element from shadow DOM.

methods.name: ensureContainerTakesSkeletonHeightWhenVisible
methods.description: Adjusts container height to prevent layout shift during skeleton display.

methods.name: getLoaderElement
methods.description: Retrieves the loader element from shadow DOM.

methods.name: toggleLoader
methods.description: Shows or hides skeleton and loader elements based on input.

methods.name: isSkeletonLoaderVisible
methods.description: Checks if the skeleton loader is currently visible.

methods.name: resizeHandler
methods.description: Handles resize events to update layout and skeleton.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the theme class based on provided theme.

methods.name: connectedCallback
methods.description: Initializes element, shows loader, and adds event listeners.

methods.name: disconnectedCallback
methods.description: Removes event listeners and cancels animation frames.
